scope: Exploratory arithmetic on all previously exposed own_boundary cohorts; leave-one-profile-out means are descriptive deletions of saved paired RMSE differences, not cross-validation, refitting, a revised evaluation, or a test.
direction: candidate minus baseline; negative favors candidate

definitions.macro_delta: Arithmetic mean of paired profile RMSE differences; original profile weights unchanged.
definitions.deletion: Arithmetic mean over the remaining n-1 saved profile differences; all n deletions retained.
definitions.MLP: Within-profile arithmetic mean of three fixed seed RMSE metrics; not an averaged-prediction ensemble.
definitions.net_improvement_share: Largest positive (baseline-candidate) divided by sum(baseline-candidate), defined only for a net improvement. Cancellation can make the share exceed one.
definitions.positive_gain_share: Largest positive gain divided by the sum of only positive gains; distinct from the net improvement share.
definitions.maximum_absolute_share: max(abs(delta_i))/abs(sum(delta_i)); can exceed one under cancellation and is not a probability.

limitations: All data were previously exposed; no fresh confirmation.
Historical role name confirmation is not a new untouched test set.
No profile was removed from canonical results or recommended for removal.
No p values, confidence intervals, refitting or optimization.
Two-profile IPMSM confirmation deletions leave just one profile.
Stable deletion direction does not establish population robustness or causal generalization.
